name: B10-0467/2025 (PfE) – Polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text:
This is a motion for a resolution from a political group in the European Parliament. It does not change any law. It expresses sympathy for the victims of the Novi Sad roof collapse, says outside interference in Serbia's affairs should stop, and criticises student protests and faculty blockades for disrupting education. It asks Serbia's own leaders, not foreign actors, to resolve the situation and stabilise the country.

- Nothing changes in law; this is a statement of political opinion only.
- It concerns Serbia's government, protesters, students and outside actors.
- It will be sent to the European Commission and Serbian authorities.
